entities.name: 5GSM capability
entities.description: Information element included in messages to indicate UE capabilities for PDU sessions, including support for reflective QoS and multi-homed IPv6 PDU sessions.

entities.name: Inter-system change from S1 mode to N1 mode
entities.description: Condition where UE moves from S1 mode to N1 mode in single-registration mode with N26 interface support.

entities.name: PDU session type conditions
entities.description: Conditions based on PDU session type (IPv4, IPv6, IPv4v6, Ethernet) and UE capability support.

entities.name: Revoke reflective QoS support
entities.description: Condition where UE needs to revoke previously indicated support for reflective QoS.

entities.name: UE supports reflective QoS
entities.description: Property indicating UE capability to support reflective QoS for PDU sessions.

entities.name: UE supports multi-homed IPv6 PDU session
entities.description: Property indicating UE capability to support multi-homed IPv6 PDU sessions.

relations.description: IE inclusion is guarded by inter-system change condition.
IE inclusion is guarded by PDU session type and capability conditions.
IE inclusion is guarded by condition to revoke reflective QoS support.
PDU session type condition establishes requirement for reflective QoS support.
PDU session type condition establishes requirement for multi-homed IPv6 support.
